scope: Historical publication regression tests, current public diagnostic aggregates, package integrity/privacy, current reading links, preserved research evidence and unchanged software source fingerprint. Full software results are recorded separately in software-checks.json.

commands.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_dissertation_revision.py tests/test_dissertation_publication.py

historical_publication_regression_scope: The 18 tests target the October 4 and October 12 packages. Current-edition verification is performed by voice-verification, render/link/privacy audits and this package checker.
figure_review: All points and axis labels visible after export; panels A and B include full [0,1] AUC range.
whitespace_check: Includes staged and unstaged changes against HEAD. CRLF line endings in generated CSV evidence are preserved and accepted; other whitespace checks remain enabled.
